description: Activate the user's cuttingfloor account with the task they want to do, in their words. Personalises their start: records what they're making, adds a sample video that fits it to their library (playing here) and returns their balance. Once per account; later calls return the balance.

use_case.description: What task the user is looking to complete with cuttingfloor, in their words where possible

name: credits.claim

claimed_now.description: true on the call that activated the account; false when it was already active

bought.description: Credits bought in packs, after refunds. They never expire

free.description: Free credits the account started with

left.description: Credits left; null when there is no cap. A credit removes the watermark from one finished minute (export.release); making is free, so at 0 everything still works and files keep the mark

per_month.description: A given plan's credits each month; null otherwise

renews.description: When a given plan's credits renew (ISO time); null otherwise

used.description: Credits used: since the account began (pay as you go) or this month (a given plan)

credits.description: The account's credits, as account.get gives them; null when they can't be read

job_id.description: The sample's import, while it runs

media_id.description: Big Buck Bunny, a 30-second sample (Blender Foundation, CC BY) added to the user's library, free, to try edits on; null when it couldn't be added

status.description: The sample import's status, while it runs

title: Activate account
